summary: Yuan–Zhang prove the averaged Colmez conjecture: the average over CM types of the Faltings heights is −½L_f'(0,η)/L_f(0,η) − ¼log(d_{E/F}d_F). They reduce it to quaternionic Shimura curves, comparing CM component heights with an arithmetic Hodge height (Theorem 1.6) and computing that height by a Gross–Zagier-type kernel and arithmetic adjunction (Theorem 1.7). The 2023 erratum replaces Theorem 2.7 by a weaker statement that suffices. Complete (cc-442dc5): every numbered statement is an item, every missing item is routed exactly once, and twenty-three findings are recorded; only E1 (the erratum) affects a stated result, and none affects Theorems 1.1, 1.6 or 1.7. Not formalised.

items.name: CM field and conjugation
items.statement: E is a characteristic-zero totally complex quadratic extension of its maximal totally real subfield F. Its canonical involution c satisfies τ(cx)=conj(τx) for every complex embedding and c²=1.

items.statement: Over any commutative ring R, finite locally free commutative affine group schemes are contravariantly equivalent to themselves by Cartier dualization; double dual is naturally isomorphic to the original.

items.name: Good-reduction differential lattice
items.statement: For an abelian variety with everywhere good reduction over OK, use its abelian/Néron model and Ω=e*Ω¹; extend homomorphisms functorially. Do not preserve arbitrary short exact sequences without a separate theorem.

items.name: Finite CM orbit average
items.statement: CU=E*\Ef*/(Ef*∩U); integrate a function on CU using |CU|^−1Σ, not its unnormalized trace. The factor e=[OE*:OF*] is separate.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: Quotient representatives, Galois orbit and normalized finite measure

items.name: Local derivative and zero-term corrections
items.statement: At nonsplit v define kφv from L(1,ηv)/vol(Ev¹) times φ1,v and the derivative of W° at a=u q(y2), with y∈B(v)−E. Define cφv from the normalized zero Whittaker derivative plus logδ(g)φ; extend general φ by fiberwise integration/linearity.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: Nearby quadratic line, normalized integral and units, P(Fv)-translation, restriction to E after subtracting singularity.

items.name: Cuspidal holomorphic projection
items.statement: Use Petersson projection Pr onto parallel-weight-two cusp forms, separating central-character components. Assumption7.1 requires two finite E-split, Q-unramified maximal-level places S2 at which r(g)φv(0,u)=0 for all g,u.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: Projection pairing characterization, growth hypotheses, restricted Pr' computation, finite/archimedean logarithmic terms.

items.name: Projected derivative decomposition
items.statement: Under Assumption7.1, Pr I'(0) equals −2Σv∫CU Kφ^(v)(g,(t,t))dt plus Σu,y∈E* (2logδf(g)+log|u q(y)|f)r(g)φ(y,u), minus Σv finite,u,y cφv(g,y,u)r(g)φ^v(y,u), minus c1 Ωφ, where c1=2Lf'(0,η)/Lf(0,η)+log(dE/dF). Archimedean K uses the regularized kernel of Theorem7.2.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Special test function and integral j
items.statement: At infinity use the standard Gaussian. At finite B-split/E-nonsplit or ordinary split v outside S2 use 1OB×OF*. At B-division use 1OB*×OF*. At v∈S2 use (1OB*−(1+q+q²)^−1 1π^−1(OB)2)1OF*, where (OB)2={x∈OB:v(qx)=2}. Choose integral j conjugating E, with v(qj)=1 iff B-division, otherwise 0.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: primitive OE-module generator to identify OB=EndOF(OE)

items.name: Integral order sandwich
items.statement: At a finite place, Dv OBv⊂OEv+OEv jv⊂OBv, with equality OEv+OEv jv=OBv iff E/F is unramified at v.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Norm congruence shells and ramified correction
items.statement: For a in the nearby represented norm class define Dn(a)={x2∈Evj: u q(x2)−a∈p^n d_v^−1}; let Dn=Dn(0). Define αv(y,u)=log q/|Dv|^1/2 ·1_(Dv^−1OE−OE)(y) Σn=0^(v(dv)−1) q^n∫Dn φv(y+x2,u)dx2.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: α has compact support away from OE.

items.name: Inert norm-shell cutoff
items.statement: If Ev/Fv is unramified quadratic and a lies in the opposite nearby norm class, Dn(a)=Dn for n≤v(a dv), and Dn(a)=∅ for n>v(a dv).
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Ramified norm-shell volume
items.statement: For ramified Ev/Fv, Dn(a)=Dn for n≤v(a dv), is empty for n>v(a dv)+v(Dv)−1, and for v(a dv)<n≤v(a dv)+v(Dv)−1 has volume |Dv|^1/2 |dv| |a| q^(v(a dv)−n).
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Inert logarithmic singularity and diagonal extension
items.statement: For inert v with §7.2 data, kφv(1,y,u)−(1/2)φv(y1,u)1OEj(y2)(v(q(y2)/q(jv))+1)log q extends to a Schwartz function; its restriction to E is φv(y,u)(|dv qjv|−1)log q/((1+q^−1)(1−q)). The jv in the singular term is the original test-function j, not the nearby j.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Ramified logarithmic singularity and diagonal extension
items.statement: For ramified v with §7.2 data, subtract (1/2)φv(y1,u)1OEj(y2)(v(qy2)+1)log q from kφv(1,y,u). It extends to Schwartz; on E its value is φv(y,u)[(|dv|−1)/(2(1−q))+(v(Dv)−1)/2]log q+αv(y,u)/2.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Archimedean zero-term correction
items.statement: For standard archimedean φ and all g,y,u, cφv(g,y,u)=0.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Finite zero-term correction
items.statement: At g=1, cφv=φv log|dv qjv| plus: inert 2φv(|dv qjv|−1)logq/((1+q^−1)(1−q)); ramified φv(|dv|−1)logq/(1−q)+αv; split zero extra term.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Picard-valued Hecke and height series
items.statement: For x∈Bf*, Z(x) is the proper correspondence from Ux=U∩xUx^−1. Form Z(g,φ)=Z0+Z* with wU-weighted coefficients r(g)φ(x,a/qx). For CM points t°, obtained by subtracting the degree-one normalized Hodge class on their component, define Z(g,(t1,t2))=⟨Z(g)t1°,t2°⟩NT.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Automorphy and cuspidality of the height series
items.statement: The Picard-valued Z(g,φ) is absolutely convergent and automorphic; the associated Néron–Tate CM height series is cuspidal.
items.locator: Theorem8.1 p606; YZZ13 Theorem3.17 and Lemma3.19
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Diagonal coefficient and modified self-intersection
items.statement: Set Ωφ=Σu∈μU²\F* Σy∈E* r(g,(t1,t2))φ(y,u). The coefficient of t2 in Z*t1 is Ωφ/e, e=[E*∩U:μU]=[OE*:OF*] at maximal level. Define i0(t,t)=i(t,t)−Σv iv(t,t)logNv, where iv is the extended local diagonal pairing, not the actual global self-intersection.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: Proper-part subtraction, global versus extended local diagonal, orbit averaging and logNv=1 at infinity.

items.name: Regularized archimedean multiplicity
items.statement: For distinct CM lifts use ms(γ)=Qs(1−2λγ), with Qs(t)=∫0∞(t+sqrt(t²−1)cosh u)^−1−s du. Define extended diagonal Green sums by excluding E* and taking the constant Laurent coefficient at s=0.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: Domain t>1, Re(s)>0 convergence, meromorphic continuation with simple pole, constant-term operation and diagonal exclusion.

items.name: Archimedean proper-height expression
items.statement: At a real place, ivbar(Z*t1,t2)proper=Mφ^(v)(g,(t1,t2))−ivbar(t2,t2)Ωφ/e, where M is the regularized ms-weighted nearby-quaternion sum.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Finite local multiplicities and diagonal omission
items.statement: At nonsplit v use the multiplicity m on B(v)v*×Ev*Bv*/Uv away from the identity class. Define mφ on B(v)v−Ev by summing over all x∈Bv*/Uv and nφ on Ev* by omitting x∈yUv. At split v use half the upper- and lower-unipotent sums.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Nonsplit proper-height expression
items.statement: For nonsplit finite v, ivbar(Z*t1,t2)proper=Mφ^(v)+Nφ^(v)−ivbar(t2,t2)Ωφ/e, with M from mφ and N from nφ, and the distinct torus-translation conventions of Proposition8.3.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Ordinary multiplicity and local pairing
items.statement: At an E-split place with Uv=(1+p^r OBv)*, mν1([[1,b],[0,1]])=1/(q^(r−v(b)−1)(q−1)) for v(b)≤r−1, supported on N(Fv)Uv/Uv; ν2 uses lower unipotents. Summing over μU\E* with away-v level indicator gives pairing of distinct CM points.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Split proper height and zero extended diagonal
items.statement: For E-split v, ivbar(t,t)=0 and ivbar(Z*t1,t2)proper=Nφ^(v), the half-sum of the two ordinary unipotent multiplicities.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Full local decomposition of the height series
items.statement: Under Assumption7.1, Z=−Σv nonsplit(logNv)∫CU Mφ^(v)−Σv finite Nφ^(v)logNv−Σv finite jv(Z*t1,t2)logNv−i0(t2,t2)Ωφ/e.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Supersingular inert local intersection
items.statement: For E-inert and B-split v, mφ(y,u)=φv(y1,u)1OEvjv(y2)·(v(qy2)+1)/2.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Wild-inclusive ramified local intersection
items.statement: For E-ramified and B-split v, mφ(y,u)=φv(y1,u)1OEvjv(y2)·(v(qy2)+v(Dv))/2, including wild ramification.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Superspecial local intersection
items.statement: For B-division (hence E-inert) v, mφ(y,u)=φv(y1,u)1OEvjv(y2)·v(qy2)/2.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Diagonal-correction local coefficient
items.statement: For every finite v and y∈Ev*, nφv(y,u)=φv(y,u) v(qy)/2 for the §7.2 functions.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Superspecial multiplicity by uniformization
items.statement: For B-division and E-inert v, m(γ,β) vanishes unless qγ qβ is a unit and γ∈Ev*(1+OE,v πv jv); in that support m(γ,β)=v(λγ)/2.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Vertical correction is nonsingular pseudo-theta
items.statement: For B-division/E-inert v and §7.2 test data, jvbar(Z*t1,t2) is a nonsingular pseudo-theta series with local kernel lφ; it extends by zero to Schwartz, supported on finitely many GL2(OFv) cosets with unit norm and unit u.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Vertical correction vanishes at B-split places
items.statement: At a finite B-split place in the maximal-level setup, jv(Z*t1,t2)=0.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Analytic–arithmetic difference is a finite pseudo-theta sum
items.statement: For §7.2 data, archimedean K−M=0; at finite nonsplit v, k−m logq extends to Schwartz; dφ=2nφ logq−cφ+(2logδ+log|uqy|)rφ extends to Schwartz on E. All but finitely many local differences vanish identically.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Nonsplit diagonal cancellation
items.statement: For nonsplit finite v, the restrictions of extended kernels to E satisfy 2kφ−2mφ logq+dφ=−log|dv q(jv)|φv.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Split diagonal cancellation
items.statement: For split finite v, dφ(1,y,u)=−log|dv q(jv)|φv(y,u).
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Nonzero associated weight-one theta
items.statement: The E-theta θΩ,1 associated to Ωφ is not identically zero: choose local Weyl elements at Σf(B)∪S2 and identity elsewhere, yielding a strictly positive constant term.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Modified self-intersection formula
items.statement: For the compact §7.2 datum, i0(P,P)/e=Lf'(0,η)/Lf(0,η)+(1/2)log(dE/F/dB), with e=[OE*:OF*].
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Residue-normalized adjunction line
items.statement: Over H, the Hilbert class field of E, let Pbar be the admissible arithmetic CM divisor, e its generic elliptic ramification index, and Mbar=LU,OH⊗O(Pbar/e). Residue gives a canonical generic trivialization M|P≃H; its integral image is a fractional ideal N with induced metric.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: local lattice length versus archimedean log norm.

items.name: Archimedean adjunction constant
items.statement: With Petersson norm ||dz||=2 Im z and Q0(t)=(1/2)log((t+1)/(t−1)), the limit of m0(z0,z1)−log(2 Im z1/|z1−z0|) as z1→z0 is 0, so −log||1||w=iw(P,P)/e.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Extended local diagonal vanishes at small away-v level
items.statement: For nonsplit finite v, with U'v sufficiently small and U'v normal in Uv away from v as in §9.2, ivbar([1]U',[1]U')=0. For split v it is zero without shrinking.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Geometric realization of extended self-intersection
items.statement: For sufficiently small U'=Uv U'^v with U'^v normal, and a chosen section P' of the pullback CM divisor over the completed maximal-unramified local base R, iw(P,P)=⟨π*PR−eP',P'⟩; the intersection is proper.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Finite adjunction lattice identity
items.statement: For the residue image N at a finite place w, Nw contains OHw and length(Nw/OHw)=iw(P,P)/e.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Arithmetic adjunction for the CM point
items.statement: For compact §7.2 data, i0(P,P)/[OE*:OF*]=−h_LU(P).
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Quaternionic CM Hodge height
items.statement: For totally definite incoherent B with at least two ramified places, E/F embedded adelically, maximal U containing OEhat*, and no common finite ramification, h_LU(PU)=−Lf'(0,η)/Lf(0,η)+(1/2)log(dB/dE/F).
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Averaged Colmez theorem in finite-Hecke normalization
items.statement: For every CM field E with maximal totally real F and [E:Q]=2g, with Yuan–Zhang's Faltings metric, 2^−gΣall 2^g CM types Φ h(Φ)=−(1/2)Lf'(0,η)/Lf(0,η)−(1/4)log(dE/F dF).
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Projective system of regular PEL models
items.statement: The models X'_{n,U'^p}, with n prime to d_B and U'^p contained in U'(N) for some N≥3 prime to p, form a projective system of regular schemes over O_℘. The special fibre of each above ℘ is a smooth curve if ℘∤n d_B and a relative Mumford curve if ℘ | d_B.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Comparison of the quaternionic and PEL p-divisible groups
items.statement: The p-divisible groups H|X_1^0 = (B_p/O_{B,p}) × X^0/O^1_{B,p} and H'|X_1'^0 are isomorphic, compatibly with the actions of Δ_0/O^1_{B,p} ⊂ Δ'_0/O^1_{B,p}.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Finite-level comparison of connected components
items.statement: For every ideal n of O_F dividing a power of p and prime to d_B, and every sufficiently small open compact U^p ⊂ G(Q̂^p) depending on n, there is an open compact U'^p ⊂ G'(Q̂^p) such that X^0_{n,U^p} ≃ X'^0_{n,U'^p} over K = F̂_℘^ur.
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Determinant lattice at the torus point
items.statement: The universal deformation of H''_{x''} as p-divisible O_{E,p}-module is the formal completion of X''_{1,℘'} at x'', and N''_{x''} = det W(H''_{x''}) ⊗ det W(H''^t_{x''}) as O_K-lattices in ω^{-2}_{X''_{1,℘'},x''}.
items.locator: Corollary 5.5 and the display before it, pp575–576
items.note: No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.

items.name: Two auxiliary split places
items.statement: A set S2 of two non-archimedean places of F, split in E and unramified over Q, such that for v ∈ S2 the group U_v is maximal and r(g)φ_v(0,u)=0 for all g ∈ GL2(F_v) and u ∈ F_v^×.
items.note: This is exactly [YZZ13, Assumption 5.4]. No exact declaration located in the bounded pinned-library/atlas screen. Source route supplies a finer specialized target, not a claim that its broad owner is absent.
api: The set S2 and its two conditions as a predicate on (U, φ)
the §7.2 test function at S2 satisfies it
